notes.title: 🧗 New Update: Advanced Climbing System is Here!
notes.notes:
This update completely overhauls the climbing mechanics! Now, your character can:

✅ Climb smoothly and realistically with new animations.
🏢 Reach previously inaccessible rooftops, military barriers, and high structures!
🎥 Enjoy fluid animations and natural climbing movements for a more immersive experience.

🆕 New Features:
🔹 Climbing animations for different surfaces
🔹 Fully reworked climbing mechanics
🔹 More natural movement transitions
🔹 Support for climbing ledges, ladders, pipes, and obstacles

💬 Your Feedback is Important!
Let us know what you think about this new mechanic! We will continue improving it based on community feedback.

📌 Download the update now and start climbing like never before!
